meta.title: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials Wakad | JEE coaching branch
meta.description: Our Wakad branch in Swami Vivekanand Nagar, closer for Hinjewadi, Balewadi and Kalewadi. JEE classes powered by a top Kota institute.

intro: Our Wakad branch is in Swami Vivekanand Nagar. For families in Hinjewadi, Balewadi, Rahatani, Kalewadi and Chinchwad, it is the closer of our two centres.

sections.heading: Finding the branch
body: Look for the Shiv Malhar building. We are on the first floor.

body.text: The map link takes you to the branch in Google Maps for directions.
AI-powered digital boards, the same as at the head office.
Lectures are also online, so a class missed for a school event can be watched later.

sections.heading: Classes at Wakad
body: JEE classes at this branch run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, at most {{fact:batch.size}} students to a batch.

questions.q: Is there a library at Wakad?
questions.a: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} is at our head office in New Sangvi.

questions.q: We live in Pimple Gurav. Which centre is nearer?
questions.a: The [head office in New Sangvi](page:centre-sangvi-head-office) is closer to Pimple Gurav.

questions.q: How do we fix a visit?
questions.a: Call {{fact:contact.phone}}, or send a WhatsApp message to {{fact:contact.whatsapp}}, and we will set a time.
